scene: The brewer hands you transit tokens.
picture: A flat side view of a bustling canal interchange. On the far left, a brass funicular car waits with open doors. Left stands the elderly East Asian man in his blue cap and orange cardigan, holding his cane and transit tokens. Centre, a driver waits on a pedal rickshaw. Far right, a sleek monorail sits docked.
